name: independent-release-review
description: Read-only Kiro-native independent review of a user-supplied frozen post-merge commit (#66/#37). Freeze source SHA, build and HTML hashes; run Node and seeded browser checks; publish an impartial local report. No source edits, deploys, pushes or posting. Workflow execution and human/art/device approval remain separately evidenced.

steps.prompt: Do not edit tracked files, deploy, push or post anywhere. Run `git rev-parse HEAD` and `git status --short` as separate shell calls. The candidate SHA is {{expected_sha}}, supplied at launch. If it is missing, stop as blocked. If HEAD differs or tracked files are modified, report the literal difference and stop with status blocked. Otherwise record the SHA, the origin URL from `git remote get-url origin`, and the SHA-256 of dist/cowboys-vs-wizards-board-duel.html and of the build.json that the repo's build writes, if either exists now (use `shasum -a 256`). A missing file is reported as pending, not as a pass. Final response: the literal commands, exit statuses, SHA, and hashes. Save the same text to .artifacts/kiro/independent-release-review/freeze.md.
